songs.name: Iditarod
songs.lyrics:
Littered with realism, marred by objectivity, acquire

Commited to seeing the inside, getting close to the edges by getting by.
More distance, abstract space created by real mood swings over grated intentions, over innocent wishes, over years of learning.
Average birth weight over fresh steps toward a lifetime of confrontation. Bare walls glowing by the dull electric glow. The genius raped by the entrepeneur

The genius raped by the entrepeneur.
The passerby by the opportunist.
Is this what we've been reduced to?


The encoded interpretation of messages sent: people observed; and conclusions anew with each breath has left me overwhelmed.
The imagination is internal... and just as active as in the days of my youth.
And I am still young, not 90, not near death.
Only too occasionally willing to sacrifice the whole collective... to the collective whole.
It's hard to be reread by anyone else, easily facts can be assumed and possessed.
Unfortunately actions need more than time to be born of ambition.
In between two legs... and two legs walking faster, is 3 feet of space.
In that space cartharsis is substitute for sleep; but exhaustion and restrain endure;
and a net, however crumbling, lay watch, feigning protection and security... over the observer.

songs.name: Still Life With Candle
songs.lyrics:
"Are you going to bed yet?"
"I haven't decided... I might have to go to the bathroom and I have planned on eating something... and I might, no probably not."
"What?"
"Read, I'll probably not read."

It was no wonder, he had been watching TV all day.
The energy he was expending just to keep his eyes half open seemed to be more than he had left.
Certainly more than would allow him to stand up straight.
Now he had always had a slump in his posture but until now he managed to convince that it was a great weight, and a worthy struggle against said unnamed weight.
Now with greasy hair, and a flatter looking forehead...
He wore the slump of an old deflated man.
The deflated man turned away from the other and shut his door. There was a candle burning on the desk.

Illuminating the soft white blank pages of an open notebook. In front of that notebook he sat.

His posture seemed better suited for sitting.
He imagined his head hanging from a chain attached to the ceiling and base of his neck.
Leaving his head three inches from the still blank pages.
He would have appeared like a marionette if he turned to see his shadow against the wall.
His shadow, instead of dancing as most shadows do when thrown by candle light
Just moved to and fro.. changing perspectives
Like a sculptor wondering where his last chisel would land.
Or if the last one were necessary at all.

With the pen in his left hand, he still hand one there despite the still blank pages three inches from his eyes left and right. He began to carve a heart into the side of the candle. It was a small heart, it would have easily fit within the confines of a coin. But upon completion... he carved the heart away with the same hand that still held the pen.

album: The Story Becomes The Vehicle / Conversations And Smokescreens (2000)

songs.name: The Story Becomes The Vehicle
songs.lyrics:
Everything happens in circles,
Rotations that curve around a powerful body
Lines to intersect
I put the tape recorder on hold, and fiction from two years ago rolled from my fingers, deleting, deleting, deleting... deleting the main figure in an act of deliverance... deliberation... the lead was had
Rotations on an intersect course, re-navigated by the simple turn of a head... The pieces are in their places, let the analysis roll forth
I've only just begun to realise the obvious powers of honesty, and the delicate timing between words, and silence
In between moments of vision, the precious few that allow for enlightenment, the optimism has become tainted, and the stoic has a demand for his skills
Void of any description, but quite clear in his intentions, the tone tells the story, becomes the vehicle
The words seem to indicate something lost within a struggle
The tight confines of a room occupied by two people who were once so close... symmetry sought perfection
Symmetry sought perfection, and realized that the interpretations numbered too great

songs.name: Conversations And Smokescreens
songs.lyrics:
Apartments of windows,
complexes of complexes, opportunities saunter by as the ghosts of interpretation breathe
Barely alive, barely affecting the colors shown through from the walls behind
Swallowed and engulfed, the hands, the hands communicate an urgency
A spark from these city walls and the whole place would go down, still cleaning up after itself, but down just the same
The only common bonds left are the ones that travel silently by train

Dormant and stuffed in our ears, friendships now replaced by common decency
So this is posturing... in this light we all look a little anxious, and lonely like carnivores
If only a gun were pulled, that might divert some of the attention away
We all sleep awkward with our bodies.
Our shoulders, should-haves and wide eyes in to the haze, the truth is so evident
Breath falling off the tails of cigarette smoke into conversations and smokescreens...

songs.name: Robots Dream in Black and White
songs.lyrics:
We talked
Like noises
That go away
When lights turn on

Stuccoed wallpaper matted my tunnel vision
As if I were walking into a cannon
To get to the sunrise at the other end
Jazz spilled on to the streets
In oiled puddles depleted by trampled impatience
I paid attention to shoes now
I paid attention to shoes now mostly wet
Footprints piled upon each other
And became a linoleum carpet for the pavement
Being not invisible, but revealing nothing
We huddled into the corner
And professed our innocence
I half expected myself to wake up in different skin
Or at least to smell a little differently
I stayed awake most of the early morning
The dawning sun backlit the sumac bush behind my drawn shades
Pulling the strings
Pulling the strings
I rose

songs.name: Somnambulism
songs.lyrics:
With respect to time
With respect to distance
A new theory of obsolescence
A calculation of momentum
Receive directions for total failure

I'm prepared for the unavoidable
Another night without sleep
Pace the room for hours, wearing heel marks in the floor
Starting blankly at the television screen

Suspended animation
Brings to bear on this condition
It's not hoplessness, but a desperate plea
I'm going nowhere

Nervous energy courses through veins
Sleepwalking into walls
Going nowhere

With respect to movement
With respect to progress
Reach an understanding of motivation
Catharsis only leads to a new complication
Inspect the engine, It's going nowhere

Time
Distance
Going
Nowhere

songs.name: Resuscitation
songs.lyrics:
It took longer than i thought it would, to find a blank space
And my heart pounded loudly as i thought of... and began to write again
Thinking of the Largeness
The impending Alien Landing at your forehead
Readying for landing, like a hairnet
But the paper felt smooth to my steady hands... and for now, hope and excitement endured

Eight through eleven ran through me like knives...
Killers
I though of blood
Blue like atmosphere dripping down the sides of buildings
I lose (?) in my stomach
I got too involved and stopped thinking

My handwriting stood up a bit in these poorly worded confessions
And my brain like dragging hands reached to the not too distant past
Each snare drum kicked me back

songs.name: Escape Artist
songs.lyrics:
Exit the stage
Exit the stage
Exit the stage
Exit the stage

Put my body on the line
Tie it to the railroad tracks
Perform the dissection
Cut your calluses open

Let's see him try to get out of this one
Let's see him try to escape from this one

Lock my body in a cell
Behind the iron door
Chained to objectivity
Immersed in disbelief

Take apart the apparatus
Redesign the operation
Hide the evidence
Of the sleight hand

Magic is machinery
A mechanism for distraction
Hide the evidence
Of the slight of hand

Let's see him try to get out of this one
Let's see him try to escape this one
Escape

songs.name: The Death of Ivan Ilych
songs.lyrics:
Turn the lights on
Turn the lights on
Turn the lights on
Turn the lights on

We can only hide in shadows so long
Before we see we need the lights on

If i had rope
I could tie the alligator down
But these days he thinks often enough to do the opposite of what is expected of him
And backed to be turned around and sideways to be stretched out
With his head in the clouds

We can only hide in shadows so long
Before we see we need the lights on

If i had rope
Id of decorated the whole word by now
Sees constellations in broken glass
Looking for the north star with no astrological map

My feet pound holes in the sidewalk that my ankles can't climb
Stand independent with honesty for legs
Expectations casting shadows headfuls of advice in my stomach are rejected whilst i become digested

Turn the lights on
Turn the lights off

songs.name: Astronaut
songs.lyrics:
This body is an astronaut
Drowning in space with his helmet cut off
And the softest glow off home
Is the beauty revealed before his eyes explode
When hope is lost your legs may as well be cut off
'cause it won't be through, till it's swallowed him whole

In absence of atmosphere
In absence of oxygen
In absence of gravity
In absence of anything

The muscles inside your face
They point towards home
And the cobwebs hang from the windows ashes
And the beacon flashes

This body is an astronaut
Drowning in space with his helmet cut off
And the softest glow off home
Is the beauty revealed before his eyes explode
When hope is lost your legs may as well be cut off
'cause it won't be through, till it's swallowed him whole

songs.name: La Machine Est Morte
songs.lyrics:
This machine is breaking down
Can we fix the circuitry?
Can we replace the battery?
Retrofit the retrograde

These calipers to calibrate
Calculate the distance
The tools we use are useless
Cut the wires with your bare hands

This machine is breaking down
Can we fix the circuitry?
Can we replace the battery?
Retrofit the retrograde

The circumstantial evidence
Leads to one conclusion
This machine is broken
It may never work again

Some teach with genius
But most teach with acquired knowledge
Limited by pin dot experience
Friends tell you nothing that they aren't willing to console
So why not slow down or stop completely and regroup
Salinger meets with Tolstoy there and is shot dead, or should be
Then i am rescued from self doubt and conspiracy

This machine is broken down (this machine is broken)
We can not fix the circuitry (this machine is broken)
We can't replace the battery (this machine is broken)
Retrofit the retrograde (this machine is broken)

songs.name: Cymbals vs. Skateboards
songs.lyrics:
The sky is doing push ups
Getting stronger as the sunset burns away
Should be teaching us laws of ratio and probability
Don't mess with inevitability

It's magnetized and reflected off refrigeration trucks
Tin in appearance... and jagged in temperature

The headlights flash off road only so far to show that the bridge is held together by sticks
Its a fragile shade that we frequent if not touched by recklessness, then will age nicely

Buildings on either side of the street provide a frame
As the sun came down around me
Might have been the whole universe opening its eyes upon my arms
And my arms went powerless

My whole body perhaps because i had become large, weak and invisible
Invisible as a smile swallowed my face
And my face did all it could to withstand the stark contrast of cold pavement
A pillow of blood for a rest that would be much needed

I threw a pen across the room
And it bounced right back at me
This is all i have
This torture
Yet I feel lucky
And i felt lucky even upon impact
If you saw it coming
Would you run away?

A pillow of blood for a rest that will be much needed
And all I want I could provide

songs.name: Idaho
songs.lyrics:
History grows in backyards and the attic sits softly

The chorus is weeping and the violins hum quietly
So don't keep the ghosts company
Advice used caution, and pieces of sanity
With the suitcase empty
I can't tell my fingernails from floorboards
Clutched to this wooden object, Kept from time
I'll sit out on the sidelines
Stick a frame on me, time set the oils dry
For when you visit occasion

This is where the fun begins
This is where Idaho begins

Stick a frame on me, time set the oils dry
For when you visit on occasion

I shiver on sensation
We coddle observation
For when you visit on occasion
Our instincts take vacation

This is where the fun begins
This is where Idaho begins
This is where the eyesight lives and breathes in antique things

songs.name: Horizons
songs.lyrics:
The sky pressed into the palm
And released strain
Thoughts of individual reality streams
And wasted conclusions
A yellow line mends the seem
And is pointed right at me
In it you can sense that perfection is forever all around us
And not meant to be human

Uncertainty is not so easily shaken
Uncertainty is not so easily shaken

Perfection is when everything stops
Becomes stone in line to be broken
And motion forever will allow

Everything has become whole
Each degree of speed can be collapsed and superimposed
Twisted in the orange line there is no movement

In the orange line there is no movement
But uncertainty is not so easily shaken

Everything has become whole
Everything has become whole
Each degree of speed can be collapsed, and superimposed
In the orange line there is no movement
Everything had become whole
